description: The rendered webhook integration shape consumed by the AI Gateway.

extractors.description: The routes of this integration. Each one serves a method and a path under the route of the connector the integration is attached to.
extractors.title: extractors

failClose.description: If true, when any non-user-facing platform stage fails during request handling (extractor, mapper, analyzer, content policy, body read, etc.), the request is rejected. When false (default), the request is allowed through unanalyzed (fail-open), trading safety for availability. User-facing decisions (Unauthorized, Forbidden, Deny, Ask) are unaffected and continue to be enforced. Default false.
failClose.title: failClose

lib.description: If set, this snippet of lua will be available in all webhook extractors of the integration, acting as an effective library. It must be a valid lua module. It will be available to all extractors by doing local plib = require('plib').
lib.title: lib

maxBodySize.description: The maximum size in bytes of a request body the route of the integration accepts. A larger body is rejected without being inspected. When it is 0, the system default applies.
maxBodySize.title: maxBodySize

name.description: The name of the webhook integration.
name.title: name

namespace.description: The namespace of the underlying webhook integration.
namespace.title: namespace

redactContent.description: If true, the user data is removed from the logged roundtrip while the analysis and all other metadata are kept. It only applies to routes whose mode is Scan. On a Police route the access policy decides this.
redactContent.title: redactContent

redactContentBypass.description: If true, and redactContent is also true, the user data is kept in the logged roundtrip whenever the analysis reports a violation, so the content behind a finding stays available for review. It has no effect on its own, and like redactContent it only applies to Scan-mode routes.
redactContentBypass.title: redactContentBypass

timeout.description: How long a call may take in total, including the scan or police pass. When it elapses, the call is answered according to failClose. When empty, the system default applies.
timeout.title: timeout
